title: Senior Manager, EDT Data Operations
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific. **What you will do:**  

* Lead operational governance and execution activities across the Data organization to ensure consistency, transparency, and accountability.
* Establish and manage operational processes, service management practices, performance measurement frameworks, and operating rhythms.
* Develop and monitor operational KPIs, service metrics, delivery performance indicators, and business outcome measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational efficiency, process optimization, automation, and organizational effectiveness.
* Partner with Delivery, Product Management, Analytics, Platform, Governance, and business teams to improve planning, execution, and operational performance.
* Oversee operational reporting, executive dashboards, performance reviews, and leadership\-ready operational insights.
* Facilitate issue management, escalation processes, service reviews, and cross\-functional coordination to address operational challenges.
* Establish operational readiness and transition processes for new capabilities, data products, services, and support models.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise governance, risk management, information security, privacy, and operational control requirements.
* Drive standardization of operating procedures, documentation, runbooks, controls, and service delivery practices across the organization.
* Develop and mentor operational leaders and team members while fostering accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.


Knowledge and Capabilities:  

* Creates an inclusive team environment and demonstrates care and concern for team members across backgrounds and geographies.
* Demonstrates tact and diplomacy in complex situations, resolves conflict constructively, and stays calm under pressure.
* Develops team capability through coaching, feedback, career development, and clear expectations.
* Demonstrates executive presence and adapts communication style for senior leaders, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
* Influences decisions by presenting structured recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, and data\-driven insights.
* Uses business acumen to connect operational performance with value delivery, cost transparency, risk reduction, and customer outcomes.
* Deals well with ambiguity and makes sound decisions with relevant but not always complete information.
 **What you need:**  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Management, Analytics, or related discipline required. Master’s degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in data operations or technology operations. 8\+ years of experience in operations management, business operations, PMO, service management, data operations, or enterprise delivery organizations.
* 5\+ years leading operational, governance, or business support teams.
* Experience establishing operational frameworks, performance management processes, service management practices, and organizational governance models.
* Experience developing KPIs, scorecards, executive reporting, operational dashboards, and performance measurement programs.
* Demonstrated success driving operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives in complex enterprise environments.
**Preferred Skills / Engineering tools:**  

* Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL, Agile, service management, or process improvement certification preferred.
* Experience with executive dashboards, operational scorecards, service reviews, and governance forums strongly desired.


Certifications:  

* Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL, Agile, or related operational disciplines preferred.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Sr. Solution Consultant III
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.



What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture.



Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.



Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.



Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next \- together!


We are looking for a self\-motivated **Sr.** **SOLUTION CONSULTANT** to join our Asia Presales team, to support our Philippines business\- An excellent opportunity for candidates who are looking for regional exposure and willing to relocate to Philippines.



A position with Anaplan's presales team means being part of one of the fastest growing cloud vendors and making your mark on a changing industry. You get to meld your love of numbers with your love of sales and be rewarded for success with an outstanding commission structure in a fast moving, stimulating environment. As a Solution Consultant, you enjoy helping people solve hard problems. You are a bit savvy about cool products and you love showing people how those products can help their businesses.  

You will join a team of individuals who embrace and respect diverse perspectives, aren't afraid to push boundaries and try new insights, and are passionate about helping our customers and each other succeed. We work hard, but we also don't wait for an excuse to have fun. In fact, we're so serious about it that it's one of our core values.


**What you will be doing:**


* Engaging with targeted, large enterprise prospects to identify broken business processes and problems. Ascertaining and explaining Anaplan's outstanding ability to solve them.
* Developing planning function\-specific solutions, demos, and messaging. Building Proof of Concept models that are tailored to solve prospects' problems.
* Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to facilitate the adoption of the Anaplan solution.
* Cross\-training teammates on solution expertise.
* Creating product awareness in the marketplace.


**More about you:**


* BS / BA / Finance or equivalent. (Post Grad and Professional Qualifications a plus)
* A background in financial planning / planning, budgeting \& forecasting / financial operation planning / financial analysis
* Experience with multi\-dimensional modelling, business intelligence, or analytics
* Prior experience in Enterprise Planning Management a plus
* Aptitude for quickly ramping up on new technology
* Excellent presentation, client relationship, and interpersonal skills\- both internally and externally


**Preferred skills and technical familiarity:**


* Growth mentality
* You're comfortable challenging old ways of doing things
* Ability to take a consultative selling approach by listening to customer needs and shaping a shared vision for a solution
* 8\+ years of presales/consulting/implementing or like experience

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!



We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**



It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.



Anaplan does not:


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.


All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.



Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.



For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)

title: Key Account Manager-Environment
description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **Job Description**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We partner with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. We are seeking a client\-focused Key Account Manager to drive strategic account growth, strengthen client relationships, and support the delivery of high\-quality consulting and engineering solutions.


The successful candidate will be responsible for managing strategic accounts, identifying growth opportunities, coordinating cross\-functional teams, and ensuring exceptional client experiences across Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS), Sustainability, Risk Management, and Engineering Consulting projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client \& Account Management**

* Serve as the primary relationship manager for designated key accounts.
* Develop and maintain executive\-level relationships with client stakeholders.
* Understand client business priorities and align service offerings to meet evolving needs.
* Conduct account reviews and develop account growth strategies.

**Business Development \& Growth**

* Identify opportunities for account expansion, cross\-selling, and upselling of consulting and engineering services.
* Support proposal development, client presentations, and commercial discussions.
* Drive revenue growth and contribute to annual business targets.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify emerging opportunities.

**Project \& Delivery Coordination**

* Collaborate closely with technical, project management, environmental, and engineering teams.
* Ensure successful delivery of projects in accordance with client expectations.
* Facilitate communication between clients and internal delivery teams.
* Track project performance, milestones, and customer satisfaction.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trusted partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Support senior leadership in account planning and strategic decision\-making.
* Lead client meetings, business reviews, and solution workshops.

**Customer Success**

* Proactively address client concerns and escalations.
* Ensure consistently high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
* Gather feedback and recommend improvements to strengthen service delivery.

  

**Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Business Administration, or related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in Key Account Management, Client Services, Consulting Sales, Business Development, or Strategic Account Management.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise or strategic client relationships.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building abilities

  

**Additional Information** **Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA in Marketing, Operations, or Business Management.
* Experience in EHS Consulting, Environmental Services, Sustainability, Infrastructure, Engineering, or Risk Management sectors.
* Knowledge of CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* Experience working in a matrix organization and cross\-functional environment.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic Account Management
* Client Relationship Management
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Business Development
* Commercial Acumen
* Project Coordination
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Solution Selling
* Revenue Growth Management
* Customer Success \& Retention


At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**


You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community \- where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.  

  

The Business Services Team (BST) consists of various functional professionals, including our business management and operations team members, who work to ensure that BCG is running smoothly, efficiently, and productively.
  

Members of this team contribute directly to the success of our business through a number of roles, including executive and administrative assistants, visual service artists, receptionists, facilities staff, and the team leaders and office coordinators who manage these operations and business management jobs.  



  

  

What You'll Do


As an Administrative Assistant (AA), you will provide high\-quality administrative and operational support to multiple senior stakeholders across global regions, including APAC, EMESA, and the US. You will serve as a trusted business partner, enabling stakeholders to operate effectively by proactively managing day\-to\-day administrative priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
  

  

At BCG, Administrative Assistants are integral members of the Business Services Team (BST). We encourage continuous learning and professional development, empowering AAs to build new capabilities and grow alongside the evolving needs of the business.
  

In this role, you will take ownership of complex calendars and schedules, anticipate stakeholder needs, coordinate activities across multiple times zones, and manage confidential information with professionalism, sound judgment, and discretion.
  

  

By providing seamless administrative support, you will help maximize stakeholder productivity and enable leaders to focus on strategic and value\-added priorities.
  

  

You will collaborate closely with Administrative Assistants and business support colleagues across BCG's global organization to ensure seamless coverage, knowledge sharing, and consistent service delivery. As business needs evolve, you may also provide backup support and undertake additional responsibilities assigned by your manager.

 **Executive \& Calendar Management**: Proactively manage complex calendars, prioritize competing demands, coordinate meetings across multiple global time zones, and optimize stakeholders' time through effective scheduling, planning, and coordination.

 **Stakeholder Partnership**: Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams by delivering responsive, reliable, and professional support while exercising sound judgment, confidentiality, and discretion in all interactions.

 **Travel \& Expense Management**: Coordinate end\-to\-end domestic and international travel, prepare and manage travel itineraries, process expense reports accurately and in a timely manner and proactively resolve travel\-related issues to ensure a seamless stakeholder experience.

 **Operational Support**: Deliver high\-quality administrative support through meeting and event coordination, preparation of business documents and presentations, maintenance of accurate records, and continuous process improvement. Collaborate closely with the Administrative Assistant community to ensure seamless coverage, knowledge sharing, and consistent service excellence.

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
* 4\+ years of professional experience in a multinational organization, professional services, or a similar fast\-paced environment.
* Experience supporting global stakeholders and managing competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment is an advantage.
* Prior experience in an administrative, executive support, or coordination role is preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  

Additional info


You're Good At

* Thriving in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and service\-oriented environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders through professionalism, responsiveness, reliability, and a customer\-first mindset.
* Applying policies and guidelines with appropriate flexibility while upholding BCG's values and culture.
* Working effectively within a complex, matrixed, and global organization.
* Managing competing priorities with excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion and integrity.
* Communicating effectively with stakeholders across cultures, geographies, and organizational levels.
* Collaborating across teams by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and contributing to a positive, high\-performing team culture.

 **Key Competencies**

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective relationships across all organizational levels.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and prioritization skills with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, reliability, and a strong commitment to delivering results.
* Demonstrates a proactive mindset by anticipating stakeholder needs, identifying opportunities for improvement, and delivering value\-added support.
* Strong customer service mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional stakeholder experiences.
* Ability to remain calm, adaptable, and resilient under pressure.
* Demonstrates sound judgment, professionalism, and the highest standards of ethics and confidentiality.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities.
* Excellent time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple competing deadlines while maintaining accuracy and quality.

  

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.


For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.


We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
